en.text:
Splits off 55% of the Weapon's Bodyshot damage into a Explosive Payload that detonates after a 0.6 second delay. The Payload deals 30% increased damage in PvE and staggers PvE Combatants more.

The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.

<pve/>[PvE] Total damage is increased by ~16.5% of the weapon's Bodyshot damage. On Crits, the overall increase is 10.9% for Adaptive/Precision Hand Cannons and 10.17% for Aggressive Hand Cannons.

<pvp/>[PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.
